entities.title: Native-first examples
entities.summary: What Python's standard library does for each task of docs/example-tests.md, one module per standard module and class, compared with UTV.
entities.purpose: Holds the native-first example suite: test_datetime_date.py, test_datetime_time.py, test_datetime_datetime.py, test_datetime_timedelta.py, test_zoneinfo_zone_info.py, test_calendar.py and test_json.py, one TestCase per function. Where the standard library and UTV agree, a test computes its expected value with UTV; where they differ, it is a literal and the docstring says what UTV does instead.
boundaries: The standard library's zone operations read this machine's tz database, so these tests need one that knows the 2026–2027 rules of New York and Paris. UTV's side uses ../fixtures.py (demo_zone_rules).
No task markers: only the UTV-first suite feeds docs/side-by-side.md.
